plan.thoughts: Saturday has strong outdoor demand. I split the hikers between a history-minded Franklin afternoon and a photography-minded Gorge morning, so the keenest hikers aren't all stacked into one outing. The two FIXED evening events (Kraken at 7pm, Vault music at 7pm) went to people who actually like sports, beer or live music, and I left out anyone who avoids late nights. Mornings spread across volunteering, running, coffee and pickleball so different neighbors get a slot, and an afternoon paddle catches the kayakers. Groups stay small (4 each) so people actually talk, and each is built around a shared second interest such as history, photography, dog walks or craft beer.

resolve.thoughts: Every member of all ten groups said yes to the original time, and nobody declined or countered. That means no alternates are needed and no times change, so all groups are kept as planned. No one needs to be asked anything, since confirmations go out after the lock.
